objective: Replace load-more triad with 4 paradigms: (1) block select default (2) all items currently on page (3) page + load-more expansion (4) pagination with page limit or all, one dataset per page saved as a collection.
success_conditions: UI exposes 4 paradigms; block is default; whole-page extracts all loaded matching items; load-more auto-discovers and expands; pagination respects page count/all and writes one dataset per page plus a collection
